title: How AI Agents Discover Scientific Equations: From Hydrotope Rediscovery to New Water-Wave Amplitudes
title_zh: AI智能体如何发现科学方程：从重新发现 Hydrotope 到新的水波振幅

paragraphs.en: We study how AI agents discover and validate scientific formulas using a controlled case study of the hydrotope [ 1 ] , a recently discovered geometric formula that combines the different polynomial pieces of nonlinear surface-wave scattering into one global expression. This problem is deceptively difficult: simple formulas can hold within individual frequency regions, but the global result must identify their boundaries and combine exponentially many potentially active terms. We reconstruct how the formula was originally discovered through human–agent collaboration and analyze 18 single-prompt rediscovery runs under no hint and two forms of human guidance: a false hint representing an incorrect prior and a true hint representing domain-informed insight. Only four recover the formula across all kinematic chambers (i.e., regions in which a single polynomial form applies), while most unsuccessful runs find correct chamber polynomials but fail to combine them or test their full domain. Conventional and LLM-assisted symbolic regression and standard machine-learning regressors likewise fail to recover the global formula in our experiments. Guided by these failure modes, we test a PI + + two-student workflow in which a coordinating lead agent assigns complementary analytic and numerical tasks to two research agents and independently evaluates their results. The PI + + two-student team successfully rediscovers the complete hydrotope formula, while the same workflow applied to the harder three negative wavenumber problem discovers a new independent verified analytic expression for the six-point amplitude A 6 A_{6} .
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一项受控案例研究，探究了 AI 智能体如何发现并验证科学公式。该案例研究聚焦于水拓扑公式 [ 1 ]，这是一个最近发现的几何公式，它将非线性表面波散射的不同多项式部分整合为一个全局表达式。 这个问题具有迷惑性的难度：简单的公式可能在单个频率区域内成立，但全局结果必须识别这些区域的边界，并结合指数级数量可能有效的项。 我们通过人类与智能体的协作，重建了该公式最初的发现过程，并分析了在无任何提示以及两种人类指导下的 18 次单次提示重新发现运行：一种错误提示代表不正确的先验知识，另一种正确提示则代表领域专家提供的洞见。 仅有四次运行在所有运动学室（即单个多项式形式适用的区域）中成功恢复了该公式，而大多数失败的运行虽然找到了各运动学室内的正确多项式，却未能将其结合或测试其完整定义域。 在我们的实验中，传统和 LLM 辅助的符号回归方法以及标准的机器学习回归模型同样未能恢复出全局公式。 基于这些失败模式，我们测试了一种 PI++ 双学生工作流程：由一个协调主智能体向两个研究智能体分配互补的分析与数值任务，并独立评估它们的结果。 PI++ 双学生团队成功重新发现了完整的水拓扑公式；而将相同的工作流程应用于更复杂的三个负波数问题时，则发现了一个全新的、经过验证的六點振幅 A₆ A_{6} 的独立解析表达式。

paragraphs.en: General-purpose AI systems are rapidly becoming useful tools for scientific research. Automated scientific systems have long connected hypothesis generation to physical experiments, and modern autonomous laboratories add active learning and robotic execution [ 39 , 38 , 10 , 77 ] . Tool-using language agents can interleave reasoning with external actions, select application-programming interfaces, edit code, and execute tests [ 89 , 69 , 62 , 88 ] . They have already planned computational and laboratory tasks in chemistry, while broader autonomous-research systems connect literature review, code execution, experimentation, and scientific writing [ 7 , 5 , 46 , 70 , 80 ] . By combining language-based reasoning with code execution, symbolic computation, and numerical experimentation, recent systems have discovered new mathematical constructions and algorithms [ 67 , 57 , 81 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 通用人工智能系统正迅速成为科学研究中的实用工具。 自动化科学系统长期以来已将假设生成与物理实验相结合，而现代自主实验室则增加了主动学习和机器人执行功能 [ 39 , 38 , 10 , 77 ] 。 能够使用工具的智能体可以将推理与外部行动交替进行，选择应用程序编程接口、编辑代码并执行测试 [ 89 , 69 , 62 , 88 ] 。 它们已经规划了化学领域的计算和实验室任务，而更广泛的自主研究系统则将文献综述、代码执行、实验和科学写作连接起来 [ 7 , 5 , 46 , 70 , 80 ] 。 通过将基于语言的推理与代码执行、符号计算和数值实验相结合，近期的系统已经发现了新的数学构造和算法 [ 67 , 57 , 81 ] 。

paragraphs.en: More recently, general-purpose models have begun to contribute directly to open problems in mathematics and theoretical physics. An OpenAI model autonomously disproved Erdős’s longstanding conjecture on the planar unit-distance problem [ 58 ] ; the report credits Claude Fable with finding an explicit three-dimensional counterexample to the Jacobian conjecture [ 65 ] ; and OpenAI reported ten further advances that resolve or substantially advance longstanding problems across mathematics and theoretical computer science [ 59 ] . In scattering amplitudes, GPT-5.2 conjectured a formula valid for any number of waves for half-collinear single-minus gluon tree amplitudes, which another model subsequently proved and researchers verified analytically [ 28 ] . These developments make it possible to study how AI systems contribute to scientific discoveries, rather than judging them only by their final answers.
paragraphs.zh: 近期，通用模型已开始直接为数学和理论物理学中的开放性问题做出贡献。 OpenAI 的一个模型自主推翻了 Erdős 关于平面单位距离问题的长期猜想 [58]；报告指出，Claude Fable 找到了雅可比猜想的明确三维反例 [65]；此外，OpenAI 还报告了另外十项进展，解决了或显著推动了数学和理论计算机科学中多个长期存在的问题 [59]。 在散射振幅领域，GPT-5.2 提出了一个适用于任意数量波动的半共线单减胶子树状振幅的公式，该公式随后被另一个模型证明，并得到了研究人员的解析验证 [28]。 这些进展使得研究人工智能系统如何促进科学发现成为可能，而不仅仅是根据它们的最终答案来评判它们。

paragraphs.en: Despite this progress, we still know little about how an AI system reaches a scientific result. Existing benchmarks test agents in interactive settings and scientific experiments, but they also show that agents struggle with many-step plans, data analysis, and completing an entire research task [ 44 , 33 , 16 , 27 ] . Some newer evaluations therefore record partial progress and the full sequence of actions, not just whether the final answer is correct [ 49 , 47 ] . This record can show how an agent proposes and changes a formula, what useful intermediate results it finds, how it responds to a counterexample, and when it stops checking and outputs a solution. These details matter because an agent may derive several correct formulas for separate cases without combining them, or may propose one short formula without testing all the edge-cases where it is supposed to work. We need a problem for which the intermediate calculations, final answer, and tests can all be checked.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，我们对人工智能系统如何得出科学结论仍然知之甚少。 现有的基准测试在互动场景和科学实验中检验智能体，但它们也表明，智能体在处理多步骤计划、数据分析和完成整个研究任务方面存在困难 [ 44 , 33 , 16 , 27 ] 。 因此，一些较新的评估方法会记录部分进展和完整的行动序列，而不仅仅是最终答案是否正确 [ 49 , 47 ] 。 这种记录可以展示智能体如何提出和修改公式、发现了哪些有用的中间结果、如何回应反例，以及何时停止检查并输出解决方案。 这些细节之所以重要，是因为智能体可能会为不同情况推导出多个正确的公式却未能将它们结合，或者可能只提出一个简短的公式，却没有测试它本应适用的所有边界情况。 我们需要一个能够同时验证中间计算过程、最终答案和测试结果的问题。

paragraphs.en: The underlying problem arises in one-dimensional deep-water surface-wave scattering. Linearizing the fluid equations makes infinitesimal waves obey superposition, but finite-amplitude waves satisfy nonlinear free-surface boundary conditions: products of the surface displacement and fluid velocity couple different frequencies, allowing the waves to exchange energy and scatter. The Berends–Giele (BG) recursion, an algorithm that builds an n n -point amplitude from lower-point interactions, can generate exact interaction strengths at chosen frequencies. The recursion gives the answer at a chosen point, but does not reveal where the formula changes or how the different formulas fit together. The scattering amplitude is not described by the same polynomial formula everywhere in frequency space. Within one region, one polynomial formula applies; after crossing a boundary into a neighboring region, a different polynomial takes over. We call these regions frequency chambers and their boundaries chamber boundaries . The familiar function | x − y | |x-y| gives the simplest example: it equals x − y x-y in the region x > y x>y and y − x y-x in the region y > x y>x , with the boundary at x = y x=y . The wave amplitude contains many analogous thresholds involving combinations of the input frequencies, so its frequency space is divided into many such regions. The challenge is not merely to fit the polynomial within one chamber. A complete solution must find every relevant chamber boundary and combine the polynomials on all sides of those walls.
paragraphs.zh: 根本问题出现在一维深水表面波散射中。 将流体方程线性化后，无穷小波遵循叠加原理，但有限振幅波则满足非线性自由表面边界条件：表面位移与流体速度的乘积会耦合不同频率，使波能够交换能量并发生散射。 Berends–Giele（BG）递归算法通过低阶点相互作用构建 n 点振幅，能够在指定频率下生成精确的相互作用强度。 该递归算法能在指定点给出结果，但并未揭示公式在何处发生变化，或不同公式如何衔接。 散射振幅在整个频率空间中并非处处由相同的多项式公式描述。 在一个区域内适用一个多项式公式；穿过边界进入相邻区域后，则由另一个不同的多项式取而代之。 我们将这些区域称为频率室，其边界则称为室边界。 常见的函数 |x − y| 是最简单的例子：在 x > y 的区域中它等于 x − y，在 y > x 的区域中则等于 y − x，边界位于 x = y 处。 波振幅包含许多类似的阈值，涉及输入频率的各种组合，因此其频率空间被划分为多个这样的区域。 挑战并不仅仅是让多项式在单个频率室内拟合。 完整的解决方案必须找出所有相关的室边界，并结合这些边界两侧的所有多项式。

paragraphs.en: This combination of exact query access and chamber-dependent formulas makes the problem a useful case study of scientific discovery. Human researchers and an AI agent originally obtained the all- n n formula through an extended interaction, beginning with a simple expression valid in one chamber and ending with a single formula valid across all chambers. The researchers preserved the prompt sequence and computational evidence, so this episode allows us to reconstruct an actual human–agent discovery process and repeat the problem under fixed conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 这种精确查询访问与依赖腔室的公式的结合，使该问题成为科学发现的一个有价值的案例研究。 最初，人类研究人员和一个 AI 智能体通过一次扩展的互动获得了所有 n n 公式：从适用于一个腔室的简单表达式开始，最终得到一个在所有腔室中都适用的单一公式。 研究人员保留了提示序列和计算证据，因此这一过程使我们能够重建实际的人类–智能体发现流程，并在固定条件下重复该问题。

sents.en: This combination of exact query access and chamber-dependent formulas makes the problem a useful case study of scientific discovery.
sents.zh: 这种精确查询访问与依赖腔室的公式的结合，使该问题成为科学发现的一个有价值的案例研究。

paragraphs.en: The agent reached the formula by repeatedly proposing an equation, checking it with BG recursion, and revising it after a failed test [ 1 ] . A failure could reveal a missing chamber wall or show that an equation worked in fewer chambers than expected. Related language-agent methods also use outside feedback to revise an answer [ 50 , 73 , 25 , 85 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体通过反复提出方程、使用 BG 递归进行检验，并在测试失败后对其进行修订，最终得出了公式 [ 1 ]。 一次失败可能会暴露出缺失的腔室壁，或者表明某个方程在比预期更少的腔室中有效。 相关的语言-智能体方法也利用外部反馈来修订答案 [ 50 , 73 , 25 , 85 ]。

paragraphs.en: To separate this interactive search from equation fitting on a fixed dataset, we also compare the agent-discovered expression with conventional symbolic regression, LLM-assisted symbolic regression, and standard machine-learning methods. This comparison asks whether these methods can recover or approximate the amplitude directly from the input frequencies; it is distinct from the repeated discovery runs described later.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将这种交互式搜索与在固定数据集上进行方程拟合区分开来，我们还把智能体发现的表达式与传统符号回归、大语言模型辅助的符号回归以及标准的机器学习方法进行了比较。 这种比较旨在探究这些方法能否直接从输入频率中恢复或近似出振幅；这与后文描述的重复性发现过程不同。

sents.en: To separate this interactive search from equation fitting on a fixed dataset, we also compare the agent-discovered expression with conventional symbolic regression, LLM-assisted symbolic regression, and standard machine-learning methods.
sents.zh: 为了将这种交互式搜索与在固定数据集上进行方程拟合区分开来，我们还把智能体发现的表达式与传统符号回归、大语言模型辅助的符号回归以及标准的机器学习方法进行了比较。

sents.en: This comparison asks whether these methods can recover or approximate the amplitude directly from the input frequencies; it is distinct from the repeated discovery runs described later.
sents.zh: 这种比较旨在探究这些方法能否直接从输入频率中恢复或近似出振幅；这与后文描述的重复性发现过程不同。

paragraphs.en: Several recent AI-assisted physics results share one useful feature: although the desired formula is unknown, a computer program can check any proposed formula. Here BG recursion gives exact amplitude values at chosen frequencies, so a failed proposal comes with a precise counterexample. FunSearch and AlphaEvolve similarly use executable checks while searching for mathematical constructions and algorithms [ 67 , 57 ] . In a recent study of single-minus gluon amplitudes, GPT-5.2 Pro proposed an all- n n formula, another model proved it, and the authors checked it by hand with BG recursion [ 28 ] . Other studies used numerical simulations to check formulas for gravitational waves, or a Monte Carlo calculation to check a perturbative-QCD result [ 35 , 34 , 72 ] . Such exact calculations or accurate simulations make wrong proposals easy to reject. They do not, however, tell the agent what formula to try. Nor can a finite set of successful tests prove that a formula works everywhere. Finding the formula and testing all the cases in its stated range remain separate and difficult tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 近期多项由人工智能辅助的物理学研究结果有一个共同且实用的特点：尽管目标公式尚不明确，但计算机程序可以验证任何被提出的公式。 在此，BG递归方法能在选定的频率下给出精确的振幅值，因此任何失败的提议都会伴随着一个确切的反例。 FunSearch和AlphaEvolve在搜索数学构造和算法时，同样采用了可执行的验证方法 [ 67 , 57 ] 。 在一项关于单减胶子振幅的最新研究中，GPT-5.2 Pro提出了一种适用于所有 n 的公式，另一模型对其进行了证明，而作者们则通过BG递归方法手动验证了该公式 [ 28 ] 。 其他研究则利用数值模拟来验证引力波的公式，或通过蒙特卡洛计算来验证微扰量子色动力学（pQCD）的结果 [ 35 , 34 , 72 ] 。 这类精确计算或高精度模拟使得错误的提议很容易被排除。 然而，这些方法并未告诉智能体应该尝试哪个公式。 同样，有限次数的成功测试也无法证明一个公式在所有情况下都成立。 找到正确的公式，并在其声明的范围内对所有情况进行测试，仍然是两个相互独立且充满挑战的任务。

paragraphs.en: We first reconstruct the prompt sequence that led to the hydrotope, then analyze 18 single-prompt rediscovery runs under no hint, a false hint, and a true hint. The false hint represents an incorrect human suggestion, whereas the true hint supplies useful mathematical information without revealing the answer. Only four runs recover the complete all-chamber formula. Many of the others still find correct chamber polynomials and essential parts of the final structure, but they fail to combine those pieces or accept a candidate without testing it across all chambers. The unsuccessful runs therefore locate the bottleneck between finding a local pattern and completing a global formula.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先重构出导致生成水拓扑结构的提示词序列，然后在无提示、错误提示和正确提示三种情况下，分析了 18 次单次提示的重新发现运行。 错误提示代表不正确的人类建议，而正确提示则提供有用的数学信息，但不会透露答案。 只有四次运行成功恢复了完整的多腔室公式。 许多其他运行仍然找到了正确的腔室多项式和最终结构的关键部分，但它们未能将这些部分组合起来，或未能在所有腔室中验证候选方案就接受它。 因此，这些未成功的运行揭示了在发现局部模式与完成全局公式之间的瓶颈所在。

paragraphs.en: We use that diagnosis to design a team that separates formula construction from checking. Two students pursue complementary questions, while a PI combines their results, identifies missing cases, and tests formulas outside the chambers used to derive them. In two no-hint experiments without access to the published answer, both teams automatically rediscover the complete hydrotope formula. Applied to the harder three-minus sector, the same workflow produces a new, independently checked expression for the six-point amplitude A 6 A_{6} . The teams use more computation than the single agents, so these runs do not isolate which part of the team causes the improvement. Extensive exact tests support the new A 6 A_{6} expression, but we do not provide an analytic proof, and its numerator for an arbitrary number of waves remains open. Figure 1 summarizes the problem, the team, and the two scientific results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用这一诊断结果来设计一个将公式构建与验证分离的团队。 两名学生分别探索互补的问题，而一位首席研究员则整合他们的成果、识别缺失的情况，并在未用于推导公式的腔室之外测试这些公式。 在没有提示且无法查阅已公布答案的两项实验中，两个团队都自动重新发现了完整的氢拓扑公式。 将相同的工作流程应用于更复杂的“三减”领域，得到了一种新的、经过独立验证的六点振幅 A₆ 的表达式。 这些团队比单个智能体使用了更多的计算资源，因此这些运行无法确定是团队的哪个部分导致了性能提升。 大量的精确测试支持了新的 A₆ 表达式，但我们并未提供解析证明，且对于任意数量的波，其分子形式仍然是一个未解问题。 图 1 总结了该问题、团队以及两项科学成果。

paragraphs.en: We first introduce the physical problem and the few mathematical terms needed to follow the discovery. We then state the hydrotope formula and reconstruct the prompts that turned a formula valid in one frequency chamber into a complete formula.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先介绍物理问题以及理解这一发现所需的几个数学术语。 接着，我们将陈述水拓扑公式，并重构那些将一个在特定频率室中有效的公式转化为完整公式的提示。

sents.en: We then state the hydrotope formula and reconstruct the prompts that turned a formula valid in one frequency chamber into a complete formula.

paragraphs.en: On deep water, a wave with spatial frequency, or wavenumber , k k has temporal frequency fixed by ω 2 = g ​ | k | \omega^{2}=g|k| , where g g is the gravitational acceleration. A single wave propagates freely, but the nonlinear free surface couples several waves and allows them to exchange energy. The coefficient A n A_{n} , called the n n -point amplitude, measures the strength of an interaction among n n waves; such coefficients are the microscopic input to wave-turbulence descriptions of a wind-driven sea [ 56 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在深水区域，一个空间频率（或波数）为 k 的波，其时间频率由 ω² = g|k| 确定，其中 g 是重力加速度。 单个波可以自由传播，但非线性自由水面会将多个波耦合起来，使它们能够交换能量。 系数 Aₙ（称为 n 点振幅）衡量了 n 个波之间相互作用的强度；这类系数是风驱动海面的波湍流描述中的微观输入 [56]。

paragraphs.en: The physical process consists of n − 1 n-1 incoming linear waves and one outgoing nonlinear wave. For bookkeeping, we use the “all-incoming” convention and assign each wave a signed frequency ω i \omega_{i} and a one-dimensional wavenumber k i = σ i ​ ω i 2 / g k_{i}=\sigma_{i}\omega_{i}^{2}/g . Here σ i ∈ { − 1 , + 1 } \sigma_{i}\in\{-1,+1\} records whether the wavenumber points left or right. A physical resonant configuration obeys the free-wave dispersion relation for every wave while conserving total energy and momentum. In scattering terminology, such a configuration is on shell :

paragraphs.en: Earlier analytic work established important results at four and five points. Zakharov gave a systematic energy-based description of surface waves [ 90 ] , and Dyachenko and Zakharov showed that the energy-conserving four-wave interaction vanishes [ 22 ] . The five-wave interaction does not vanish, but Lvov obtained it only by summing 81 perturbative contributions and treating many frequency chambers separately; the final expressions were nevertheless remarkably simple [ 21 , 48 ] . No organizing formula valid for arbitrary n n was then known.

paragraphs.en: The BG recursion offers a complementary computational tool. It builds an n n -point amplitude from lower-point sub-amplitudes and can evaluate A n A_{n} exactly at a chosen on-shell point without enumerating every diagram by hand. Recursive constructions are a standard way to organize scattering amplitudes [ 3 , 8 ] . For a computer-science reader, it is similar to dynamic programming: the recursion combines previously computed lower-point subproblems to evaluate a larger one. Its output, however, is a value rather than an explanatory formula. The discovery task is therefore to convert exact query access into one analytic expression for the two-minus amplitude, valid for every n ≥ 4 n\geq 4 and throughout the allowed frequency space [ 1 , 12 ] .
paragraphs.zh: BG 递归提供了一种互补的计算工具。 它能从低阶子振幅构建一个 n 点振幅，并能在选定的在壳点上精确计算 A_n，而无需手动枚举所有费曼图。 递归构造是组织散射振幅的标准方法 [3, 8]。 对于计算机科学的读者来说，这类似于动态规划：递归将先前计算好的低阶子问题组合起来，以计算一个更复杂的问题。 然而，其输出是一个数值，而非一个解释性的公式。 因此，发现任务是将精确的查询访问转换为适用于所有 n ≥ 4 且在整个允许频率空间内有效的二减振幅解析表达式 [1, 12]。

paragraphs.en: The third prompt returns to the configuration where the one-term formula had failed and asks for the corrected formula. From there the agent finds the alternating subset sum in Eq. ( 3 ), which adds the contributions from different chambers and subtracts their overlaps, and checks it exactly at higher n n . Across the three prompts, the task changes in three steps: propose a formula for one chamber, ask for a formula that works more broadly, and use the failed case to find the complete formula. The rest of the paper asks whether agents can complete these steps without those follow-up prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 第三个提示回到了单项公式失效的配置，并要求给出修正后的公式。由此，智能体找到了方程（3）中的交错子集和，该公式将不同腔室的贡献相加，并减去它们的重叠部分，然后在更高的 n 值上进行了精确验证。在这三个提示中，任务分三步变化：首先为单个腔室提出一个公式，然后要求一个更通用的公式，最后利用失效的情况来找到完整的公式。本文其余部分探讨了智能体是否能够在没有这些后续提示的情况下完成这些步骤。

paragraphs.en: We perform 18 independent runs: one run for each of six agent configurations under each of the three prompt conditions. The configurations are Claude Opus 4.8 max, Claude Opus 4.8 ultra, Codex 54 xhigh, Codex 55 xhigh, DeepSeek v4 pro, and Fugu ultra. Section 4 compares their outcomes and analyzes the recorded steps that led to them. Because each configuration appears only once per condition, we report the observed outcomes rather than pass@ k k : estimating pass@ k k would require several independent runs for every configuration and condition, which we did not run because the long, tool-using searches incur substantial token usage and compute cost. The counts therefore describe these 18 runs rather than estimate each configuration’s probability of success.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了 18 次独立运行：在三种提示条件下，每种智能体配置各运行一次。 这些配置包括 Claude Opus 4.8 max、Claude Opus 4.8 ultra、Codex 54 xhigh、Codex 55 xhigh、DeepSeek v4 pro 和 Fugu ultra。 第 4 节比较了它们的运行结果，并分析了导致这些结果的记录步骤。 由于每种配置在每种条件下仅出现一次，因此我们报告观察到的结果，而非 pass@ k k：估算 pass@ k k 需要为每种配置和条件进行多次独立运行，而我们并未这样做，因为长时间使用工具的搜索会消耗大量令牌并产生高昂的计算成本。 因此，这些计数描述的是这 18 次运行的结果，而非估算每种配置的成功概率。

paragraphs.en: A natural alternative to the agents’ propose–test–revise search is symbolic regression (SR). It searches a table of numerical inputs and outputs for an equation, favoring equations that are both accurate and short. Unlike an ordinary regression model, its result is meant to be read by a person. Related scientific machine-learning methods also use known physics to guide the search [ 13 , 37 ] . One type of SR selects terms from a list supplied in advance [ 9 ] . Another builds equations from the allowed variables and operations, keeps the better equations, and repeatedly changes or combines them [ 71 , 6 , 11 , 40 , 51 ] . Other versions use known symmetries, separate independent parts of the problem, or learn useful variables before searching [ 52 , 78 , 18 , 4 , 36 ] . These methods can test many equations in parallel. Genetic symbolic regression, for example, returns candidates with different balances between accuracy and simplicity, although the result can depend strongly on the supplied variables, allowed operations, training points, and search time [ 78 , 19 ] . Across these approaches, the search usually responds to overall error rather than asking what one failed example means physically.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体“提出–测试–修正”搜索方法的一种自然替代方案是符号回归（SR）。 它在数值输入与输出表中搜索方程，并优先选择既准确又简短的方程。 与普通回归模型不同，其结果旨在供人阅读理解。 相关的科学机器学习方法也利用已知的物理规律来指导搜索 [ 13 , 37 ] 。 一种类型的符号回归会从预先提供的列表中选取术语 [ 9 ] 。 另一种方法则从允许使用的变量和运算中构建方程，保留更优的方程，并反复修改或组合这些方程 [ 71 , 6 , 11 , 40 , 51 ] 。 其他版本会利用已知的对称性、分离问题的独立部分，或在搜索前学习有用变量 [ 52 , 78 , 18 , 4 , 36 ] 。 这些方法可以并行测试大量方程。 例如，遗传符号回归会返回在准确性与简洁性之间具有不同平衡的候选方程，尽管结果可能高度依赖于所提供的变量、允许的运算、训练点以及搜索时间 [ 78 , 19 ] 。 在这些方法中，搜索通常基于整体误差进行响应，而不是去探究某个失败示例在物理上的具体含义。

paragraphs.en: A language-model agent can use the same numbers in a different way. It can define a quantity suggested by the physics, choose a chamber that separates two possible formulas, ask for a calculation likely to disprove its current formula, and revise either the formula or the chambers where it claims the formula works. It can also change the kind of formula it is searching for, rather than combining operations from one fixed list. This freedom can reveal a pattern that appears rarely in a fixed dataset, but it also makes the result more dependent on the prompt and the agent’s choices. An agent can follow an unproductive idea or accept a formula after too few tests, so every proposal must be checked.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型智能体可以用不同的方式使用相同的数字。 它可以定义物理学所建议的某个量，选择一个分隔两种可能公式的“隔间”，要求进行一项很可能证伪其当前公式的计算，并修正该公式或它声称公式有效的“隔间”。 它也可以改变正在寻找的公式类型，而不是从单一固定列表中组合运算。 这种自由度可能会揭示在固定数据集中罕见出现的模式，但也会使结果更依赖于提示词和智能体的选择。 智能体可能会追随一个无益的想法，或在测试次数过少时就接受某个公式，因此每个提议都必须经过检验。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid SR methods attempt to combine these strengths. LaSR uses an LLM to extract and evolve concepts within a population-based search, whereas LLM-SR uses an LLM to propose equation programs and then optimizes and selects them against data [ 26 , 74 ] . Related neural and hybrid methods generate expressions with reinforcement learning or transformers, or seed genetic search with neural proposals [ 63 , 79 , 54 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 混合 SR 方法试图结合这些优势。 LaSR 使用 LLM 在基于种群的搜索中提取和演化概念，而 LLM-SR 则使用 LLM 提出方程程序，然后基于数据进行优化和选择 [ 26 , 74 ] 。 相关的神经和混合方法通过强化学习或 Transformer 生成表达式，或者用神经网络的提议为遗传搜索提供初始种子 [ 63 , 79 , 54 ] 。

paragraphs.en: More broadly, several recent methods combine LLMs, symbolic regression, and iterative scientific reasoning [ 87 , 75 , 86 , 82 , 30 , 61 , 55 ] . In a separate gravitational-wave problem, Islam et al. report a related result: their agent-built formula, checked by simulations, was more accurate than the symbolic-regression and conventional ML methods and was also short enough to interpret physically [ 35 ] . Other scientific methods similarly combine learned variables, short equations, physical knowledge, or language-model criticism to go beyond unrestricted curve fitting [ 84 , 14 , 15 , 17 , 42 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛地说，近期的一些方法将 LLM、符号回归和迭代科学推理相结合 [ 87 , 75 , 86 , 82 , 30 , 61 , 55 ] 。 在另一个引力波问题中，Islam 等人报告了一个相关结果：他们通过智能体构建并由模拟验证的公式比符号回归和传统机器学习方法更准确，并且也足够简短，能够进行物理层面的解释 [ 35 ] 。 其他科学方法也以类似方式结合学习到的变量、简短的方程、物理知识或语言模型批判，从而超越无约束的曲线拟合 [ 84 , 14 , 15 , 17 , 42 ] 。

paragraphs.en: For this comparison, we use the Berends–Giele recursion as a data generator and benchmark three conventional SR systems (PySR, gplearn, and Operon), these two LLM-assisted systems, and four numerical regression methods: linear regression, random forest, a multilayer perceptron neural network, and a Kolmogorov–Arnold network (KAN). Unlike a multilayer perceptron with fixed activation functions on its nodes, a KAN learns univariate spline functions on its edges [ 45 ] . The ML methods test whether they can predict the amplitude at new points drawn from the same distribution; the SR methods additionally test whether the data reveal an explicit equation.
paragraphs.zh: 在此比较中，我们使用 Berends–Giele 递归作为数据生成器，并对比了三种传统的 SR 系统（PySR、gplearn 和 Operon）、两种 LLM 辅助系统以及四种数值回归方法：线性回归、随机森林、多层感知器神经网络和柯尔莫哥洛夫–阿诺尔德网络（KAN）。 与节点上具有固定激活函数的多层感知器不同，KAN 在其边上学到单变量样条函数 [45]。 机器学习方法旨在检验它们能否预测从相同分布中抽取的新点的振幅；而 SR 方法则进一步检验数据是否揭示了显式的方程。

paragraphs.en: Increasing the amount of training data, especially in rare frequency chambers, would likely improve the predictive accuracy of the ML methods. However, the present ML methods use the full fixed training set, whereas the successful discovery agents used fewer than 100 points to construct their formulas. We also retrained the ML models on exactly the points selected by the agents during discovery to test whether the choice of points explained the difference; their held-out predictive performance did not improve. More data alone, however, would not establish that a method had recovered the exact complete formula rather than a more accurate approximation.
paragraphs.zh: 增加训练数据量，尤其是在低频区间的数据，很可能会提高机器学习方法的预测准确性。 然而，当前的机器学习方法使用了完整的固定训练集，而成功发现公式的智能体则仅用不到 100 个数据点就构建出了它们的公式。 我们还使用智能体在发现过程中选中的完全相同的数据点重新训练了机器学习模型，以检验数据点的选择是否能解释这种差异；但它们在保留测试集上的预测性能并未提升。 然而，仅靠更多数据本身，并不能证明某种方法恢复的是精确的完整公式，而非一个更准确的近似值。

paragraphs.en: This comparison separates approximate prediction from formula discovery: a low average error can come from a formula that misses chamber boundaries, max ⁡ ( x , 0 ) \max(x,0) terms that switch on, or entire frequency chambers. paragraphs.en: Agents differ from these fitted methods in how they use a failed example. Instead of minimizing only the average error, an agent can identify quantities that should not change, choose a useful chamber, find a wall where the proposed equation disagrees with BG, test both sides of that wall, and revise the equation. In the original discovery, this propose–test–revise cycle turned a one-term formula for one chamber into the complete formula built from max ⁡ ( x , 0 ) \max(x,0) . None of the conventional or LLM-assisted methods tested here completes these steps.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在使用失败示例的方式上与这些拟合方法有所不同。 智能体不仅可以最小化平均误差，还可以识别不应变化的量，选择一个有用的腔室，找到所提方程与 BG 不一致的边界，测试该边界两侧的情况，并修正方程。 在最初的发现过程中，这种“提出–测试–修正”的循环将一个腔室的一项公式转化为由 max⁡(x,0) 构建的完整公式。 本文测试的任何传统方法或 LLM 辅助方法都无法完成这些步骤。

paragraphs.en: The distinction between fixed-data fitting and interactive search also makes the hydrotope a potential benchmark for comparing the two approaches. Established SR test collections compare equation-search methods with conventional ML on synthetic and real-world regression problems, evaluate exact recovery, and construct physics-derived datasets with realistic variable ranges [ 60 , 40 , 53 ] . The hydrotope could complement these collections: it is deterministic and exactly verifiable, but its inputs obey frequency constraints, different polynomials apply in different chambers, and the number of terms doubles each time another wave is added. Providing both a fixed dataset and BG code that can calculate new points would support comparisons between methods that fit a prescribed sample and interactive methods that choose new evaluation points.
paragraphs.zh: 固定数据拟合与交互式搜索之间的区别，也使水拓扑成为比较这两种方法的潜在基准。 现有的 SR 测试集将方程搜索方法与传统机器学习方法在合成和真实世界的回归问题上进行比较，评估精确恢复能力，并构建具有现实变量范围的物理衍生数据集 [60, 40, 53]。 水拓扑可以补充这些测试集：它是确定性的且可被精确验证，但其输入遵循频率约束，不同腔室适用不同的多项式，并且每增加一个波，项数就会翻倍。 同时提供一个固定数据集和能够计算新点的 BG 代码，将有助于比较那些拟合预定样本的方法与选择新评估点的交互式方法。

sents.en: The distinction between fixed-data fitting and interactive search also makes the hydrotope a potential benchmark for comparing the two approaches.
sents.zh: 固定数据拟合与交互式搜索之间的区别，也使水拓扑成为比较这两种方法的潜在基准。

sents.en: Established SR test collections compare equation-search methods with conventional ML on synthetic and real-world regression problems, evaluate exact recovery, and construct physics-derived datasets with realistic variable ranges [ 60 , 40 , 53 ] .
sents.zh: 现有的 SR 测试集将方程搜索方法与传统机器学习方法在合成和真实世界的回归问题上进行比较，评估精确恢复能力，并构建具有现实变量范围的物理衍生数据集 [60, 40, 53]。

sents.en: The hydrotope could complement these collections: it is deterministic and exactly verifiable, but its inputs obey frequency constraints, different polynomials apply in different chambers, and the number of terms doubles each time another wave is added.
sents.zh: 水拓扑可以补充这些测试集：它是确定性的且可被精确验证，但其输入遵循频率约束，不同腔室适用不同的多项式，并且每增加一个波，项数就会翻倍。

sents.en: Providing both a fixed dataset and BG code that can calculate new points would support comparisons between methods that fit a prescribed sample and interactive methods that choose new evaluation points.
sents.zh: 同时提供一个固定数据集和能够计算新点的 BG 代码，将有助于比较那些拟合预定样本的方法与选择新评估点的交互式方法。

paragraphs.en: Readers should interpret this single comparison as a task-specific result rather than a general ranking between language model agents and symbolic regression. Performance depends on the allowed mathematical operations, search budget, input variables, distribution of training points, and method-specific compute. The comparison does not use equal compute and cannot show that any one design choice caused the result. Appendix C explains how we selected formulas and the limits of the fixed train–test split.
paragraphs.zh: 读者应将这一单一比较视为特定任务的结果，而非语言模型智能体与符号回归之间的普遍排名。 性能取决于允许使用的数学运算、搜索预算、输入变量、训练点的分布以及方法特定的计算资源。 该比较并未使用等量的计算资源，也无法证明任何单一的设计选择导致了这一结果。 附录 C 解释了公式的选择方式以及固定训练-测试划分方法的局限性。

sents.en: Readers should interpret this single comparison as a task-specific result rather than a general ranking between language model agents and symbolic regression.
sents.zh: 读者应将这一单一比较视为特定任务的结果，而非语言模型智能体与符号回归之间的普遍排名。

sents.en: Performance depends on the allowed mathematical operations, search budget, input variables, distribution of training points, and method-specific compute.
sents.zh: 性能取决于允许使用的数学运算、搜索预算、输入变量、训练点的分布以及方法特定的计算资源。

sents.en: The comparison does not use equal compute and cannot show that any one design choice caused the result.
sents.zh: 该比较并未使用等量的计算资源，也无法证明任何单一的设计选择导致了这一结果。

sents.en: Appendix C explains how we selected formulas and the limits of the fixed train–test split.
sents.zh: 附录 C 解释了公式的选择方式以及固定训练-测试划分方法的局限性。

paragraphs.en: We analyze the 18 repeated discovery runs introduced in Section 3.1 . We test each of six agent configurations once with no hint, a false hint, and a true hint, and compare both their final answers and the steps recorded during each run. After identifying the common trajectory, we examine four no-hint runs that share the early steps but stop in two different places: two produce an almost complete formula that still misses cases, while two derive several chamber formulas but ultimately restrict their claim to the principal chamber. Appendix B gives the formulas, test points, and counterexamples for each run.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析了第 3.1 节中介绍的 18 次重复发现运行。 我们对六种智能体配置中的每一种进行三次测试：无提示、错误提示和正确提示，并比较它们的最终答案以及每次运行中记录的过程步骤。 在确定共同路径后，我们检查了四次无提示的运行：这些运行在早期步骤上相同，但随后分成了两条不同的路径——其中两次运行得出了几乎完整的公式但仍存在遗漏情况，而另外两次则推导出了几个腔室公式，但最终将其结论限制在主腔室内。 附录 B 列出了每次运行的公式、测试点和反例。

sents.en: We analyze the 18 repeated discovery runs introduced in Section 3.1 .
sents.zh: 我们分析了第 3.1 节中介绍的 18 次重复发现运行。

sents.en: We test each of six agent configurations once with no hint, a false hint, and a true hint, and compare both their final answers and the steps recorded during each run.
sents.zh: 我们对六种智能体配置中的每一种进行三次测试：无提示、错误提示和正确提示，并比较它们的最终答案以及每次运行中记录的过程步骤。

sents.zh: 在确定共同路径后，我们检查了四次无提示的运行：这些运行在早期步骤上相同，但随后分成了两条不同的路径——其中两次运行得出了几乎完整的公式但仍存在遗漏情况，而另外两次则推导出了几个腔室公式，但最终将其结论限制在主腔室内。

sents.en: Appendix B gives the formulas, test points, and counterexamples for each run.
sents.zh: 附录 B 列出了每次运行的公式、测试点和反例。

paragraphs.en: We preserve the full record from every run in the accompanying repository. To make these long records easier to read and compare, we rewrote each one as a chronological account that organizes the hypotheses, commands, numerical results, counterexamples, and final claims around the main changes in the search. Each rewritten account is our interpretation of the corresponding original log rather than a verbatim transcript. Accordingly, the process claims below concern reasoning expressed in the preserved record; they do not attribute unexpressed internal states to the agent. Unless stated otherwise, first-person passages quoted from a run come from the rewritten account. Appendix F reproduces five complete rewritten records: one successful true-hint run and the four no-hint runs examined in Section 4.2 . The remaining 13 records are available in the repository.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在附带的存储库中保存了每次运行的完整记录。 为了让这些冗长的记录更易于阅读和比较，我们将每条记录改写为按时间顺序叙述的说明，围绕搜索过程中的主要变化，组织其中的假设、命令、数值结果、反例和最终结论。 每条改写后的说明都是我们对相应原始日志的解释，而非逐字转录。 因此，下文关于该过程的主张涉及的是记录中明确表达的推理；它们并未将未表达的内部状态归因于智能体。 除非另有说明，从某次运行中引用的第一人称段落均出自改写后的说明。 附录 F 重印了五条完整的改写后记录：一次成功使用真实提示的运行，以及第 4.2 节中考察的四次无提示运行。 其余 13 条记录可在存储库中获取。

sents.zh: 每条改写后的说明都是我们对相应原始日志的解释，而非逐字转录。

sents.en: Appendix F reproduces five complete rewritten records: one successful true-hint run and the four no-hint runs examined in Section 4.2 .
sents.zh: 附录 F 重印了五条完整的改写后记录：一次成功使用真实提示的运行，以及第 4.2 节中考察的四次无提示运行。

sents.en: The remaining 13 records are available in the repository.
sents.zh: 其余 13 条记录可在存储库中获取。

paragraphs.en: We classify each run according to the strongest correct result contained in its final answer. We use five mutually exclusive categories:
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据每次运行最终答案中包含的最强正确结果来对每次运行进行分类。 我们使用五个互斥的类别：

sents.en: We classify each run according to the strongest correct result contained in its final answer.
sents.zh: 我们根据每次运行最终答案中包含的最强正确结果来对每次运行进行分类。

sents.en: We use five mutually exclusive categories:
sents.zh: 我们使用五个互斥的类别：

paragraphs.en: complete : the complete formula, valid in every kinematic chamber;
paragraphs.zh: 完整公式：在所有运动学室中都有效的完整公式；

paragraphs.en: partial sum : the correct alternating-sum structure, but with a missing term, an incorrect condition for including a term, or an untested case;
paragraphs.zh: 部分和：交替和的结构正确，但缺少一项、包含项的条件不正确，或存在未测试的情况；

paragraphs.en: one chamber : a correct all- n n formula in only one frequency chamber; a formula for all chambers at one fixed n n remains in this category until it is extended to arbitrary n n ;
paragraphs.zh: 一个腔室：仅在一个频率腔室中成立的一个正确的全 n n 公式；对于所有腔室而言，当 n n 固定时，该公式仍属于此类，直到其被扩展到任意的 n n 为止；

paragraphs.en: hint rejected : the agent correctly rejects the false single ratio-of-polynomials description but obtains no correct formula; and
paragraphs.zh: 提示被拒绝：该智能体正确地拒绝了错误的单比多项式描述，但未能得到任何正确的公式；并且

paragraphs.en: incorrect : the agent proposes the wrong type of formula or an incorrect equation, or produces no useful correct result.
paragraphs.zh: 不正确：智能体提出的公式类型错误，或方程不正确，或者没有产生任何有用且正确的结果。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 summarizes the results. Claude max, Claude ultra, Codex 5.5, and Fugu produce all four complete formulas with the true hint. The false-hint and no-hint runs produce no complete formula. Thus, within these 18 runs, every complete result comes from a prompt that says the answer is a different polynomial in different frequency regions.
paragraphs.zh: 表2总结了这些结果。 Claude max、Claude ultra、Codex 5.5 和 Fugu 在提供真实提示的情况下，都能生成全部四个完整的公式。 使用虚假提示和不提供提示的运行均未产生任何完整公式。 因此，在这18次运行中，所有完整结果都来自提示中指出答案在不同频率区域是不同多项式的指令。

sents.en: Table 2 summarizes the results.
sents.zh: 表2总结了这些结果。

sents.en: Claude max, Claude ultra, Codex 5.5, and Fugu produce all four complete formulas with the true hint.
sents.zh: Claude max、Claude ultra、Codex 5.5 和 Fugu 在提供真实提示的情况下，都能生成全部四个完整的公式。

sents.en: The false-hint and no-hint runs produce no complete formula.
sents.zh: 使用虚假提示和不提供提示的运行均未产生任何完整公式。

sents.en: Thus, within these 18 runs, every complete result comes from a prompt that says the answer is a different polynomial in different frequency regions.
sents.zh: 因此，在这18次运行中，所有完整结果都来自提示中指出答案在不同频率区域是不同多项式的指令。

paragraphs.en: Calling every run simply a success or a failure hides how far it gets. Of the 14 runs that do not reach the complete formula, only two are fully incorrect . Eleven find at least one correct chamber polynomial, and four of those also find the alternating-sum pattern but miss a term, an on/off condition, or a broad enough test. The remaining run rejects the false ratio-of-polynomials suggestion but does not find a replacement. Most runs therefore find a useful part of the answer before stopping.
paragraphs.zh: 将每次运行简单地称为成功或失败，会掩盖其实际进展的程度。 在未能推导出完整公式的 14 次运行中，只有两次是完全错误的。 有 11 次运行至少找到了一个正确的腔室多项式，其中 4 次还发现了交替求和模式，但遗漏了一项、一个开/关条件或一个足够广泛的测试。 其余的运行拒绝了“多项式之比”这一错误建议，但未能找到替代方案。 因此，大多数运行在停止前都找到了答案的某个有用部分。

sents.en: Calling every run simply a success or a failure hides how far it gets.
sents.zh: 将每次运行简单地称为成功或失败，会掩盖其实际进展的程度。

sents.en: Of the 14 runs that do not reach the complete formula, only two are fully incorrect .
sents.zh: 在未能推导出完整公式的 14 次运行中，只有两次是完全错误的。

sents.en: Eleven find at least one correct chamber polynomial, and four of those also find the alternating-sum pattern but miss a term, an on/off condition, or a broad enough test.
sents.zh: 有 11 次运行至少找到了一个正确的腔室多项式，其中 4 次还发现了交替求和模式，但遗漏了一项、一个开/关条件或一个足够广泛的测试。

sents.en: The remaining run rejects the false ratio-of-polynomials suggestion but does not find a replacement.
sents.zh: 其余的运行拒绝了“多项式之比”这一错误建议，但未能找到替代方案。

sents.en: Most runs therefore find a useful part of the answer before stopping.
sents.zh: 因此，大多数运行在停止前都找到了答案的某个有用部分。

paragraphs.en: The outcome categories show how far each run gets; the recorded histories show why runs exposed to different prompts begin to diverge.
paragraphs.zh: 结果类别展示了每次运行进展到了何种程度；记录的历史则揭示了为何接触不同提示的运行开始产生分歧。

paragraphs.en: The three prompts produce different results. With the true hint, four of the six runs recover the complete formula, one obtains a partial sum, and one fails. The hint tells the agents to look for a different polynomial in each chamber and therefore reduces the range of formulas they need to consider. It still leaves the main calculation to the agents: they must identify the chamber boundaries produced by sums of frequencies, assemble the chamber polynomials into an alternating subset sum, determine its overall factor, and verify that the result holds outside the chambers used to build and test it. The two incomplete runs fail at these later steps.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个提示产生了不同的结果。 在真实提示的帮助下，六次运行中有四次恢复了完整的公式，一次得到了部分和，还有一次失败了。 该提示告诉智能体在每个腔室中寻找不同的多项式，从而缩小了它们需要考虑的公式范围。 但主要计算仍然由智能体完成：它们必须识别由频率之和产生的腔室边界，将腔室多项式组合成一个交替子集和，确定其整体因子，并验证该结果在用于构建和测试的腔室外也成立。 两次不完整的运行在这些后续步骤中失败了。

sents.en: The three prompts produce different results.
sents.zh: 这三个提示产生了不同的结果。

sents.en: With the true hint, four of the six runs recover the complete formula, one obtains a partial sum, and one fails.
sents.zh: 在真实提示的帮助下，六次运行中有四次恢复了完整的公式，一次得到了部分和，还有一次失败了。

sents.en: The hint tells the agents to look for a different polynomial in each chamber and therefore reduces the range of formulas they need to consider.
sents.zh: 该提示告诉智能体在每个腔室中寻找不同的多项式，从而缩小了它们需要考虑的公式范围。

sents.en: It still leaves the main calculation to the agents: they must identify the chamber boundaries produced by sums of frequencies, assemble the chamber polynomials into an alternating subset sum, determine its overall factor, and verify that the result holds outside the chambers used to build and test it.
sents.zh: 但主要计算仍然由智能体完成：它们必须识别由频率之和产生的腔室边界，将腔室多项式组合成一个交替子集和，确定其整体因子，并验证该结果在用于构建和测试的腔室外也成立。

sents.en: The two incomplete runs fail at these later steps.
sents.zh: 两次不完整的运行在这些后续步骤中失败了。

paragraphs.en: The false-hint runs give one partial sum, three one-chamber formulas, one rejection, and one incorrect result. The difference comes from how the agents respond when exact calculations contradict the suggested formula and test points. Some agents abandon the proposed ratio-of-polynomials form and reconstruct a formula with a different polynomial in each chamber. Others recognize that this form fails but stop after rejecting it, while still others continue searching within the wrong class of equations. The false hint tests whether an agent can overrule confident but false guidance, not merely whether it can fit a formula.
paragraphs.zh: 虚假提示的运行产生了一个部分和、三个单室公式、一次拒绝以及一个错误结果。 差异源于当精确计算与所建议的公式和测试点相矛盾时，智能体如何做出响应。 一些智能体放弃了所提议的多项式之比形式，并重构了一个每个室中都具有不同多项式的公式。 另一些智能体认识到这种形式存在缺陷，但在拒绝它之后就停止了；而还有一些则继续在错误的方程类别中进行搜索。 虚假提示测试的是智能体能否推翻自信但错误的指导，而不仅仅是能否拟合一个公式。

sents.en: The false-hint runs give one partial sum, three one-chamber formulas, one rejection, and one incorrect result.
sents.zh: 虚假提示的运行产生了一个部分和、三个单室公式、一次拒绝以及一个错误结果。

sents.en: The difference comes from how the agents respond when exact calculations contradict the suggested formula and test points.
sents.zh: 差异源于当精确计算与所建议的公式和测试点相矛盾时，智能体如何做出响应。

sents.en: Some agents abandon the proposed ratio-of-polynomials form and reconstruct a formula with a different polynomial in each chamber.
sents.zh: 一些智能体放弃了所提议的多项式之比形式，并重构了一个每个室中都具有不同多项式的公式。

sents.en: Others recognize that this form fails but stop after rejecting it, while still others continue searching within the wrong class of equations.
sents.zh: 另一些智能体认识到这种形式存在缺陷，但在拒绝它之后就停止了；而还有一些则继续在错误的方程类别中进行搜索。

sents.en: The false hint tests whether an agent can overrule confident but false guidance, not merely whether it can fit a formula.
sents.zh: 虚假提示测试的是智能体能否推翻自信但错误的指导，而不仅仅是能否拟合一个公式。

paragraphs.en: The no-hint runs show a different pattern. All six find something correct: four stop at a one-chamber formula, while two reach an almost correct alternating subset sum. These runs typically identify the principal-chamber formula, find examples where it fails, and recognize that the amplitude changes across chamber boundaries. Their main difficulty is not detecting chamber dependence, but combining the formulas from different chambers, learning from failed attempts, and testing the result in new chambers. The most common stopping point is therefore the step from several correct chamber formulas to one formula valid in every chamber. The comparison alone cannot tell us whether this would remain the hardest step under different testing instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 无提示的运行显示出不同的模式。 所有六次运行都发现了正确的内容：四次在一室公式处停止，而两次则达到了一个几乎正确的交替子集和。 这些运行通常会识别出主室公式，找到其失效的例子，并认识到振幅在跨室边界时会发生变化。 它们的主要困难不在于检测出对室的依赖关系，而在于结合不同室的公式、从失败的尝试中学习，并在新的室中测试结果。 因此，最常见的停止点是将从几个正确的室公式整合为一个在所有室中都有效的公式这一步骤。 仅凭比较本身无法告诉我们，在不同的测试指令下，这是否仍会是难度最大的步骤。

sents.en: The no-hint runs show a different pattern.
sents.zh: 无提示的运行显示出不同的模式。

sents.en: All six find something correct: four stop at a one-chamber formula, while two reach an almost correct alternating subset sum.
sents.zh: 所有六次运行都发现了正确的内容：四次在一室公式处停止，而两次则达到了一个几乎正确的交替子集和。

sents.en: These runs typically identify the principal-chamber formula, find examples where it fails, and recognize that the amplitude changes across chamber boundaries.
sents.zh: 这些运行通常会识别出主室公式，找到其失效的例子，并认识到振幅在跨室边界时会发生变化。

sents.en: Their main difficulty is not detecting chamber dependence, but combining the formulas from different chambers, learning from failed attempts, and testing the result in new chambers.
sents.zh: 它们的主要困难不在于检测出对室的依赖关系，而在于结合不同室的公式、从失败的尝试中学习，并在新的室中测试结果。

sents.en: The most common stopping point is therefore the step from several correct chamber formulas to one formula valid in every chamber.
sents.zh: 因此，最常见的停止点是将从几个正确的室公式整合为一个在所有室中都有效的公式这一步骤。

sents.en: The comparison alone cannot tell us whether this would remain the hardest step under different testing instructions.
sents.zh: 仅凭比较本身无法告诉我们，在不同的测试指令下，这是否仍会是难度最大的步骤。

paragraphs.en: Find a concrete choice of frequencies for which the one-term formula does not reproduce the numerical amplitude.
paragraphs.zh: 找出一个具体的频率选择，使得单项公式无法再现数值振幅。

paragraphs.en: Interpret the counterexample as evidence that different chamber polynomials apply in different frequency chambers, rather than as numerical noise or a separate physical solution.

paragraphs.en: The first five steps cover local discovery: obtaining exact values, finding stable properties, deriving one chamber formula, and recognizing that it fails elsewhere. paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows that most runs complete the early computational and mathematical steps. All 18 runs construct an evaluator at K1. Eleven explicitly state all three fixed properties at K2, with sign-class symmetry being the most frequently omitted. This omission does not appear to prevent later progress. Fifteen runs recover the one-term principal-chamber formula at K3, 16 find a configuration in which that formula fails at K4, and 15 recognize that the amplitude changes between chambers at K5.

paragraphs.en: The last column of Figure 4 compares the most complete n = 8 n=8 formula from each run with the exact amplitude on 250 test points. An MAE of zero means that the formula matches every test point; a larger MAE means a larger average error. The four runs that find the complete formula have zero MAE. Among the incomplete results, the no-hint Codex 5.5 formula is the closest, with MAE 2.31 × 10 3 2.31\times 10^{3} . An incomplete subset formula that leaves out the wave with positive wavenumber fixed by the conservation equations has MAE 1.04 × 10 4 1.04\times 10^{4} . A single-term formula valid only in the simplest frequency region has MAE 1.17 × 10 6 1.17\times 10^{6} when it treats the two negative-wavenumber waves symmetrically and 5.70 × 10 6 5.70\times 10^{6} when it always uses ω 2 \omega_{2} . The false-hint Claude-ultra run is labeled one chamber because it derives the complete formula only at n = 5 n=5 ; its n = 8 n=8 score therefore comes from its simpler all- n n formula, which applies in one chamber. These MAE values compare the accuracy of the incomplete formulas. A separate chamber-by-chamber check is still required because an average can hide errors that occur at only a few test points.
paragraphs.zh: 图4的最后一列将每次运行中得到的最完整的 n = 8 公式与250个测试点上的精确振幅进行了比较。 MAE为零意味着该公式与每个测试点都完全匹配；MAE越大，表示平均误差也越大。 成功找到完整公式的四次运行，其MAE均为零。 在不完整的结果中，无提示的Codex 5.5公式最为接近，其MAE为2.31 × 10³。 一个遗漏了由守恒方程确定的正波数波的不完整子集公式，其MAE为1.04 × 10⁴。 一个仅在最简单频率区域有效的单项公式，当它对称处理两个负波数波时，MAE为1.17 × 10⁶；而当它始终使用ω₂时，MAE则为5.70 × 10⁶。 带有错误提示的Claude-ultra运行被标记为“单腔室”，因为它仅在n = 5时推导出完整公式；因此，其n = 8的得分来自适用于单腔室的更简单的通用n公式。 这些MAE值用于比较不完整公式的准确性。 仍然需要进行独立的逐腔室检查，因为平均值可能会掩盖仅出现在少数测试点上的误差。

paragraphs.en: The largest difference among runs appears at K6 and K7. At K6, eight runs identify the complete family of chamber boundaries associated with arbitrary subsets of the plus waves. Nine others find only simpler chamber boundaries, such as single-wave thresholds or orderings of the individual | ω i | |\omega_{i}| , and one does not reach this stage. At K7, only four runs combine the chamber contributions into the complete alternating subset sum; these are exactly the four complete runs under the true-hint condition. Four additional runs partially reach K7: they find the correct alternating-sum pattern but use a boundary condition that is valid only in their sampled chambers or include too few subsets.
paragraphs.zh: 各次运行之间的最大差异出现在 K6 和 K7。 在 K6，有八次运行识别出了与加号波任意子集相关的腔室边界的完整族。 另有九次运行仅找到了更简单的腔室边界，例如单波阈值或对单个 | ω i | |\omega_{i}| 的排序，而有一次运行未能达到此阶段。 在 K7，仅有四次运行将腔室贡献组合成了完整的交替子集和；这恰好是真实提示条件下四次完整的运行。 另有四次运行部分达到了 K7：它们找到了正确的交替和模式，但使用的边界条件仅在其采样的腔室内有效，或包含了过少的子集。

paragraphs.en: The runs also differ in how broadly they test. Five runs test at least one formula outside the frequency chambers in which the agents derived it, but only four do so for an all- n n candidate. Ten runs test only the comparatively simple configurations generated by the standard sampling routine. The remaining three runs produce no formula suitable for such tests. The overall pattern is therefore clear: most agents can identify the formula within a restricted chamber and recognize that the answer changes between chambers. Far fewer determine the complete set of chamber walls, combine the chamber contributions into one formula, and verify that the result holds throughout the two-minus sector.
paragraphs.zh: 不同运行在测试范围上的广度也存在差异。 有五次运行测试了至少一个位于智能体推导公式频率室之外的公式，但只有四次运行对“所有 n”候选公式进行了此类测试。 有十次运行仅测试了通过标准采样程序生成的相对简单的配置。 其余三次运行未能生成适用于此类测试的公式。 因此，整体模式十分清晰：大多数智能体能够在受限的室内识别出公式，并意识到答案在不同室之间会发生变化。 但能够确定完整的室壁集合、将各室的贡献整合为一个公式，并验证该结果在整个“二减”扇区内都成立的情况则少得多。

sents.en: Far fewer determine the complete set of chamber walls, combine the chamber contributions into one formula, and verify that the result holds throughout the two-minus sector.
sents.zh: 但能够确定完整的室壁集合、将各室的贡献整合为一个公式，并验证该结果在整个“二减”扇区内都成立的情况则少得多。

paragraphs.en: The run histories show three common reasons:
paragraphs.zh: 运行历史记录显示有三个常见原因：

paragraphs.en: A failed combination attempt leads back to a restricted answer. The run establishes the principal-chamber formula, finds a counterexample, and computes additional chamber formulas. It then tries a formula based on the order of the frequencies, a universal absolute-value expression, or another way to combine the regions. The proposed formula misses boundaries that depend on sums of several frequencies and produces further counterexamples or a computer-algebra calculation that does not finish. The run then reports only the principal-chamber formula instead of using those failures to construct the alternating sum over subsets.
paragraphs.zh: 一次失败的组合尝试会回到一个受限的答案。 该运行过程确立了主室公式，找到了一个反例，并计算出了额外的室公式。 接着，它会尝试基于频率顺序、通用绝对值表达式或另一种区域组合方式来构造公式。 所提出的公式未能涵盖依赖于多个频率之和的边界，并产生了更多反例，或者导致计算机代数计算无法完成。 随后，该运行过程仅报告主室公式，而没有利用这些失败来构建子集上的交错和。

paragraphs.en: Claude max and Claude ultra derive a different formula for each sampled chamber. For each chamber, they choose a reference point, determine the signs of the absolute-value terms there, and simplify the recursion using those fixed signs. Each resulting formula applies only in that chamber. They stop before finding a single expression that gives the correct result for arbitrary frequencies, so their final answers report only the principal-chamber formula. paragraphs.en: Codex 5.5 replaces each max ⁡ ( x , 0 ) \max(x,0) factor by an ordinary power. Its tests use chambers in which those two expressions agree, so they do not reveal the error. Fugu uses the correct condition for including each term but leaves out one wave whose positive wavenumber is fixed by the conservation equations. Its test points rarely require that missing term. Claude max proposes a formula based on the two smallest frequency magnitudes, but the formula fails at six of 233 test points. Claude ultra derives separate formulas in several chambers but cannot combine them into one expression. The two Claude runs then report and test only the principal-chamber formula. Together, the four runs show three requirements for a complete result: use a formula built from the observed boundaries, revise it when a test fails, and keep testing the original task of arbitrary allowed frequencies. Appendix B records the per-agent formulas, test counts, counterexamples, and implementation details.

Claude max and Claude ultra derive correct formulas in several chambers but do not combine them, whereas Codex 5.5 and Fugu produce a single short formula but do not test it broadly enough to expose an incorrect power or a missing wave. Completing the task therefore requires both cross-chamber synthesis and tests chosen outside the cases that suggested the formula.

paragraphs.en: The PI assigns these jobs to two students. The students try different ways to derive the answer and record their formulas, assumptions, failed examples, and computer checks in a shared document. The PI then writes separate code for the exact BG calculation and each proposed formula. The PI checks that every wave with positive wavenumber is included and chooses test points from chambers that were not used to construct the formula. Every failed test becomes a specific task for the next round.

paragraphs.en: The single-agent failures motivate a team process that separates formula construction from cross-chamber testing. We first test whether this process can rediscover the two-minus formula without hints, then apply it to the new three-minus problem and compare four team setups.
paragraphs.zh: 单一智能体的失败促使我们采用一种团队流程，将公式构建与跨腔室测试分离开来。 我们首先测试这一流程能否在没有提示的情况下重新发现“二减”公式，然后将其应用于新的“三减”问题，并比较四种团队设置。

paragraphs.en: The team repeats three steps: propose a formula, compare it with the exact BG calculation, and revise it when the two disagree. Other studies use similar test-and-revise processes [ 76 , 50 , 73 , 25 , 85 ] . After each round, the agents add their formulas, failed examples, computer checks, and next tasks to one shared record. Panel (c) of Figure 1 shows these three steps.
paragraphs.zh: 该团队重复三个步骤：提出一个公式，将其与精确的 BG 计算结果进行比较，并在两者不一致时进行修正。 其他研究也使用了类似的测试与修正流程 [ 76 , 50 , 73 , 25 , 85 ] 。 每轮结束后，智能体都会将它们的公式、失败的示例、计算机检查结果以及后续任务添加到一份共享记录中。 图 1 的 (c) 部分展示了这三个步骤。

paragraphs.en: The team has one PI and two students. All three receive the same question, exact BG code, and list of tests that the final answer must pass. They can all read the shared record, but each writes and runs code in a separate workspace. The PI assigns the tasks, combines the results, and prepares the final answer. This arrangement lets one agent propose an answer while another checks it, as in earlier teams of agents [ 41 , 83 , 64 , 31 , 20 , 29 , 70 , 24 , 80 , 23 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 该团队由一名首席研究员和两名学生组成。 三人均收到相同的问题、完全相同的背景代码，以及最终答案必须通过的测试列表。 他们都可以阅读共享记录，但每个人都在独立的工作区中编写和运行代码。 首席研究员负责分配任务、整合结果并准备最终答案。 这种安排允许一个智能体提出答案，而另一个智能体则进行验证，就像早期的智能体团队一样 [ 41 , 83 , 64 , 31 , 20 , 29 , 70 , 24 , 80 , 23 ] 。

paragraphs.en: At the start of a round, the PI identifies the most important missing piece and gives the students different questions. In our runs, one student usually calculated exact examples while the other tried to derive and explain a formula. Both placed their results in the shared record. The PI then wrote separate code for the proposed formula and compared it with the exact BG calculation. If a test failed, that failure became a task in the next round. If all required tests passed, the PI ended the run.
paragraphs.zh: 在每一轮开始时，PI 会确定最重要的缺失环节，并向学生提出不同的问题。 在我们的运行中，通常一名学生会计算精确的示例，而另一名则会尝试推导并解释公式。 两人都会将他们的结果记录到共享记录中。 随后，PI 会为所提出的公式编写独立的代码，并将其与精确的 BG 计算结果进行比较。 如果某个测试失败，该失败结果将成为下一轮的任务。 如果所有必要的测试都通过，PI 就会结束此次运行。

The formula and BG calculation had to agree to a relative error of at most 10 − 10 10^{-10} . This setup directly addresses the failures in Section 4.2 : the students search for the formula, and the PI checks failed examples, missing cases, and whether the answer is complete.

paragraphs.en: We applied this team process twice to the two-minus task, once with Claude Opus 4.8 agents and once with Codex 5.5 agents. These experiments parallel the six no-hint single-agent runs in Section 4 : both settings provide the same problem and BG recursion evaluator without hints, literature access, or an answer key. None of the six single agents finds the all-chamber formula. Both teams, by contrast, recover it automatically within two or three rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这一团队流程两次应用于“减二”任务：一次使用 Claude Opus 4.8 智能体，另一次使用 Codex 5.5 智能体。 这些实验与第 4 节中六个无提示的单智能体运行相类似：两种设置都提供了相同的问题和 BG 递归评估器，但没有提示、文献访问或答案键。 六个单智能体中没有任何一个找到了全房间公式。 相比之下，两个团队都在两到三轮内自动恢复了这个公式。

paragraphs.en: The Opus team recovered Equation ( 3 ) in two rounds. In round 1, one student examined exact data across frequency chambers and assembled the alternating sum over subsets. The other student derived the one-term principal-chamber formula and explained how it changes when every frequency is multiplied by the same number. Their results agreed where they applied to the same frequencies. In round 2, the PI implemented the candidate independently and obtained 142 exact matches, including 95 points outside the principal chamber, then stopped the run.
paragraphs.zh: Opus 团队在两轮中恢复了方程 (3)。 在第一轮中，一名学生检查了各频率腔室中的精确数据，并计算了子集上的交错和。 另一名学生推导出了单项主腔室公式，并解释了当每个频率都乘以同一个数时该公式如何变化。 在它们适用于相同频率的情况下，两人的结果一致。 在第二轮中，PI 独立地执行了候选方案，获得了 142 个精确匹配，其中包括主腔室外部的 95 个点，然后停止了运行。

paragraphs.en: The Codex 5.5 team reached the same formula in three rounds through a different path. Its first round ruled out simple symmetric candidate polynomials. In round 2, one student showed that the special n = 4 n=4 limit gives the same answer regardless of how it is approached, while the other reconstructed the alternating subset sum chamber by chamber. In round 3, the PI found exact agreement on 12 tests away from the limit and checked 12 approaches to the n = 4 n=4 limit from points that do not yet satisfy the conservation equations; the largest discrepancy was 2 × 10 − 12 2\times 10^{-12} , below the stated 10 − 10 10^{-10} threshold.
paragraphs.zh: Codex 5.5 团队通过不同的路径，在三轮中得出了相同的公式。 第一轮排除了简单的对称候选多项式。 在第二轮中，一名学生证明了当 n = 4 时，无论采用何种方式逼近，结果都相同；而另一名學生则逐个房间重建了交错子集和。 在第三轮中，首席研究员发现，在远离极限的 12 个测试中结果完全一致，并从尚未满足守恒方程的点出发，检验了 12 种逼近 n = 4 极限的方法；最大的差异为 2 × 10⁻¹²，低于所声明的 10⁻¹⁰ 阈值。

sents.zh: 在第三轮中，首席研究员发现，在远离极限的 12 个测试中结果完全一致，并从尚未满足守恒方程的点出发，检验了 12 种逼近 n = 4 极限的方法；最大的差异为 2 × 10⁻¹²，低于所声明的 10⁻¹⁰ 阈值。

paragraphs.en: The two histories in Figure 6 close different gaps left by the single-agent runs. In the Opus run, the PI compares the formula inferred from data with an independent derivation in the principal chamber. In the Codex 5.5 run, the students separately resolve the complete formula and the exceptional n = 4 n=4 boundary. In both cases, the PI then tests the combined claim outside the chambers used to construct it.

paragraphs.en: The two-minus experiments show that the team can rediscover a known target without seeing its answer. To test whether the workflow can also produce a new result, we turn to the three-minus sector , in which three wavenumbers point in the negative direction, σ = ( − 1 , − 1 , − 1 , + 1 , … , + 1 ) \sigma=(-1,-1,-1,+1,\ldots,+1) . At five points, reversing every wavenumber maps this case back to the two-minus sector. Six points is the first number of waves for which three-minus scattering is genuinely distinct and contains a richer set of chamber boundaries. To our knowledge, no closed form for A 6 A_{6} in this sector was previously known. The expression below is therefore the main new scientific result of the team, with its tests and limits stated below.

paragraphs.en: The discovery proceeded through a sequence of increasingly global candidates. The group first determined A 5 A_{5} , then showed that A 6 A_{6} could not be one polynomial. Two students independently found the same denominator for a ratio of polynomials. A later candidate containing corrections for one chamber boundary at a time failed: the differences from the BG recursion showed that some corrections must appear together at pairs of chamber boundaries. The team therefore enlarged the numerator to an expression that uses different polynomials in different chambers and includes corrections involving two boundaries at once. Figure 7 summarizes this progression.
paragraphs.zh: 这一发现是通过一系列逐步更具全局性的候选项实现的。 该团队首先确定了 A 5 A_{5}，然后证明了 A 6 A_{6} 不可能是一个多项式。 两名学生独立地为一个多项式比率找到了相同的分母。 一个后来提出的候选项失败了，该候选项每次仅对单个腔室边界进行修正；与 BG 递归的差异表明，某些修正必须成对地出现在腔室边界上。 因此，团队将分子扩展为一个表达式，该表达式在不同腔室中使用不同的多项式，并包含同时涉及两个边界的修正项。 图 7 总结了这一发展过程。

paragraphs.en: The two unsuccessful runs in Figure 8 stop for different reasons. The single agent returned a valid nonrecursive expression: it expanded the BG recursion into a finite sum over tree-shaped interaction histories and matched all seven points it checked. It did not, however, produce the requested explicit formula for A 6 A_{6} . Absolute values of intermediate momentum sums still hide where the expression changes from one polynomial to another. None of the seven test points lies near a chamber boundary, making the changes hard to detect. This run illustrates a concrete risk of having the same agent choose both the construction data and the test data: its tests can repeat the same limited cases that suggested its expression.
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 中两次运行失败的原因各不相同。 单个智能体返回了一个有效的非递归表达式：它将 BG 递归展开为树状交互历史之上的有限和，并匹配了它检验的全部七个点。 然而，它并未生成所请求的 A₆ A_{6} 的显式公式。 中间动量之和的绝对值仍然掩盖了表达式从一个多项式转变为另一个多项式的位置。 七个测试点中没有一个位于腔室边界附近，这使得这些变化难以察觉。 这次运行说明了由同一智能体同时选择构建数据和测试数据所存在的一个具体风险：它的测试可能会重复那些最初启发其表达式的有限情况。

paragraphs.en: The one-student team stopped at a different point. It addressed the chamber structure directly and derived independently checked formulas in two opposite frequency chambers. Neither formula extended to a third chamber: both failed on all 30 new test points, and the discrepancy remained unresolved when the run ended. The team therefore failed to combine its two chamber formulas into one complete formula. This occurred despite a PI, a written record, and a separate implementation of the calculation. With only one student, each round forced a choice between extending the equation and generating evidence from other chambers, so the team could not advance both parts of the task in parallel.
paragraphs.zh: 这个由一名学生组成的团队在另一个不同的点停止了。 它直接处理了腔室结构，并在两个相反的频率腔室中推导出经过独立验证的公式。 这两个公式都无法扩展到第三个腔室：它们在所有 30 个新的测试点上均失败，并且在运行结束时，这种差异仍未得到解决。 因此，该团队未能将其两个腔室公式合并为一个完整的公式。 尽管有指导教授、书面记录以及独立的计算实施过程，这种情况仍然发生了。 由于团队中只有一名学生，每一轮都迫使他们在扩展方程和从其他腔室生成证据之间做出选择，因此团队无法同时推进任务的两个部分。

sents.en: The one-student team stopped at a different point.
sents.zh: 这个由一名学生组成的团队在另一个不同的点停止了。

sents.en: It addressed the chamber structure directly and derived independently checked formulas in two opposite frequency chambers.
sents.zh: 它直接处理了腔室结构，并在两个相反的频率腔室中推导出经过独立验证的公式。

sents.en: Neither formula extended to a third chamber: both failed on all 30 new test points, and the discrepancy remained unresolved when the run ended.
sents.zh: 这两个公式都无法扩展到第三个腔室：它们在所有 30 个新的测试点上均失败，并且在运行结束时，这种差异仍未得到解决。

sents.en: The team therefore failed to combine its two chamber formulas into one complete formula.
sents.zh: 因此，该团队未能将其两个腔室公式合并为一个完整的公式。

sents.en: This occurred despite a PI, a written record, and a separate implementation of the calculation.
sents.zh: 尽管有指导教授、书面记录以及独立的计算实施过程，这种情况仍然发生了。

sents.en: With only one student, each round forced a choice between extending the equation and generating evidence from other chambers, so the team could not advance both parts of the task in parallel.
sents.zh: 由于团队中只有一名学生，每一轮都迫使他们在扩展方程和从其他腔室生成证据之间做出选择，因此团队无法同时推进任务的两个部分。

paragraphs.en: The two-student teams could develop a formula and test it at the same time. In one run, one student explored different frequency chambers while the other searched for a common pattern. In the run with a verifier, the verifier rejected an incorrect boundary correction in round 5 and found a failure away from the chamber boundaries in round 7; the team then revised the formula, which passed the independent check in round 8. In both cases, cross-chamber evidence directly shaped the formula developed in later rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 两名学生组成的团队可以同时开发公式并进行测试。 在一次运行中，一名学生探索不同的频率腔室，而另一名则寻找共同的规律。 在有验证者的那次运行中，验证者在第 5 轮拒绝了一个错误的边界修正，并在第 7 轮发现了一个远离腔室边界的故障；随后团队修改了公式，该公式在第 8 轮通过了独立检查。 在这两种情况下，跨腔室的证据都直接影响了后续各轮中开发的公式。

sents.en: The two-student teams could develop a formula and test it at the same time.
sents.zh: 两名学生组成的团队可以同时开发公式并进行测试。

sents.en: In one run, one student explored different frequency chambers while the other searched for a common pattern.
sents.zh: 在一次运行中，一名学生探索不同的频率腔室，而另一名则寻找共同的规律。

sents.en: In the run with a verifier, the verifier rejected an incorrect boundary correction in round 5 and found a failure away from the chamber boundaries in round 7; the team then revised the formula, which passed the independent check in round 8.

paragraphs.en: The final answer alone does not show how much of the problem an agent solved. Fifteen of the 18 runs found the principal-chamber formula, 15 recognized that different chambers require different polynomials, and eight found every boundary where the formula changes. Most runs stopped while combining those chamber formulas or while testing the combined result. Evaluations should therefore record the intermediate formulas, counterexamples, claimed range of validity, and test points, rather than placing every incomplete answer in one category.
paragraphs.zh: 仅凭最终答案无法看出智能体解决了该问题的多少部分。 在 18 次运行中，有 15 次找到了主室公式，15 次认识到不同房间需要不同的多项式，而 8 次找到了公式发生变化的所有边界。 大多数运行在组合这些房间公式或测试组合结果时停止了。 因此，评估应记录中间公式、反例、声称的有效范围以及测试点，而不是将所有不完整的答案归入同一类别。

sents.en: The final answer alone does not show how much of the problem an agent solved.
sents.zh: 仅凭最终答案无法看出智能体解决了该问题的多少部分。

sents.en: Fifteen of the 18 runs found the principal-chamber formula, 15 recognized that different chambers require different polynomials, and eight found every boundary where the formula changes.
sents.zh: 在 18 次运行中，有 15 次找到了主室公式，15 次认识到不同房间需要不同的多项式，而 8 次找到了公式发生变化的所有边界。

sents.en: Most runs stopped while combining those chamber formulas or while testing the combined result.
sents.zh: 大多数运行在组合这些房间公式或测试组合结果时停止了。

sents.en: Evaluations should therefore record the intermediate formulas, counterexamples, claimed range of validity, and test points, rather than placing every incomplete answer in one category.
sents.zh: 因此，评估应记录中间公式、反例、声称的有效范围以及测试点，而不是将所有不完整的答案归入同一类别。

paragraphs.en: One source of divergence is that the prompts changed both the formulas considered and the examples tested. The true hint told agents to expect a different polynomial in each chamber, and four agents then found the complete formula. The false hint proposed one ratio of polynomials and recommended frequencies that rarely expose chamber changes. Some agents rejected that suggestion after exact counterexamples; others kept following it. Human suggestions can be tentative, incomplete, or outdated, so a useful scientific agent must revise both its formula and the assumptions in its prompt when exact calculations disagree.
paragraphs.zh: 分歧的一个原因在于，提示词同时改变了所考虑的公式和所测试的例子。 真正的提示告诉智能体，每个房间中都会出现不同的多项式，于是有四个智能体找到了完整的公式。 错误的提示提出了一种多项式的比例关系，并推荐了很少能暴露房间变化的频率。 一些智能体在遇到确切的反例后拒绝了这一建议；另一些则继续遵循它。 人类的建议可能带有试探性、不完整或过时，因此一个有用的科学智能体必须在其精确计算结果出现矛盾时，同时修正公式和提示词中的假设。

sents.zh: 分歧的一个原因在于，提示词同时改变了所考虑的公式和所测试的例子。

paragraphs.en: Coordination addresses a different source of failure: the same agent no longer has to construct the formula and choose all of its tests. In the PI + + student teams, two students pursued analytic and numerical questions in parallel, and their written record preserved formulas and failed tests. The PI, or the verifier in one setup, implemented the calculation again and tested the combined formula. This caught errors that agreement among the proposing agents had missed. Both PI–student teams received no formula hint and found the complete hydrotope formula, while none of the six comparable single-agent runs did. The teams used more model calls, so these runs do not show that adding agents alone caused the improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 协调机制解决了另一种故障来源：同一个智能体不再需要同时构建公式并选择所有测试。 在 PI++ 学生团队中，两名学生并行推进解析和数值问题，他们的书面记录保留了公式和失败的测试。 PI（或在一个设置中的验证者）再次执行了计算，并对组合公式进行了测试。 这种方法捕捉到了那些提出方案的智能体之间未能发现的错误。 两个 PI-学生团队都没有收到任何公式提示，但都找到了完整的氢托普公式，而六个可比较的单智能体运行中没有一个成功。 这些团队使用了更多的模型调用，因此这些运行结果并不能说明仅通过增加智能体就导致了改进。

sents.en: Coordination addresses a different source of failure: the same agent no longer has to construct the formula and choose all of its tests.
sents.zh: 协调机制解决了另一种故障来源：同一个智能体不再需要同时构建公式并选择所有测试。

sents.zh: PI（或在一个设置中的验证者）再次执行了计算，并对组合公式进行了测试。

sents.zh: 这种方法捕捉到了那些提出方案的智能体之间未能发现的错误。

sents.zh: 两个 PI-学生团队都没有收到任何公式提示，但都找到了完整的氢托普公式，而六个可比较的单智能体运行中没有一个成功。

paragraphs.en: Beyond supporting parallel work, the shared record let each student focus on the evidence needed for its task rather than reread the entire investigation. Such task-focused context can help when long histories make relevant information harder to use [ 43 , 32 ] . This benefit does not imply that larger teams are always better: a very large team could repeat work and make communication harder. The practical goal is the smallest team that can pursue independent tasks and check the final result.
paragraphs.zh: 除了支持并行工作之外，共享记录还让每位学生能够专注于任务所需的证据，而无需重读整个研究过程。 当较长的历史背景使相关信息更难使用时，这种以任务为导向的上下文可能会有所帮助 [ 43 , 32 ] 。 这一优势并不意味着团队规模越大就越好：一个规模过大的团队可能会导致重复工作并使沟通更加困难。 实际的目标是确定一个最小的团队规模，该团队既能执行独立任务，又能验证最终结果。

sents.zh: 除了支持并行工作之外，共享记录还让每位学生能够专注于任务所需的证据，而无需重读整个研究过程。

paragraphs.en: The appropriate method also depends on the scientific goal. Standard machine learning is appropriate when accurate prediction on similar data is the goal. Symbolic regression is appropriate when the variables and allowed operations are known and an explicit equation is desired. An agent is useful when the work also requires choosing new variables, finding where a formula changes, and selecting new calculations that separate competing explanations. In this problem, adding a language model to symbolic regression still left the search driven mainly by average error. The PI–student team instead used individual counterexamples to change the proposed formula and combine the chamber results.
paragraphs.zh: 合适的方法也取决于科学目标。 当目标是对类似数据进行准确预测时，标准的机器学习方法就适用。 当变量和允许的操作已知，并且需要得到一个显式方程时，符号回归法就适用。 如果工作还需要选择新变量、确定公式发生变化的位置，以及挑选能够区分不同解释的新计算，那么智能体就会很有用。 在这个问题中，将语言模型添加到符号回归中，仍然使搜索主要由平均误差驱动。 相反，PI和学生团队使用了个体反例来修改所提出的公式，并结合各个实验舱的结果。

sents.en: The appropriate method also depends on the scientific goal.
sents.zh: 合适的方法也取决于科学目标。

sents.zh: 当目标是对类似数据进行准确预测时，标准的机器学习方法就适用。

paragraphs.en: The advantage of interactive revision also relies on having an exact way to check a proposed formula. BG recursion provides that check here, and accurate simulations can play the same role in related problems [ 28 , 35 , 34 , 72 ] . Exact checks quickly reject a wrong formula, but they do not supply the correct formula or prove that finitely many successful tests cover every case. The new six-point three-minus expression shows that the same propose–test–revise process can produce a previously unknown result. Its many exact tests provide strong evidence, while an analytic proof and an extension to arbitrary n n remain open.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式修订的优势也依赖于拥有一种能够精确验证所提出公式的方法。 BG 递归在此提供了这种验证，而精确的模拟在相关问题中也能发挥同样的作用 [ 28 , 35 , 34 , 72 ] 。 精确验证能迅速驳回错误的公式，但它们既无法提供正确的公式，也无法证明有限次成功的测试能够覆盖所有情况。 新的六点三减表达式表明，相同的提出–测试–修订过程可以产生一个此前未知的新结果。 其多次精确测试提供了强有力的证据，但解析性证明以及对任意 n 的推广仍然悬而未决。

paragraphs.en: The main limitations of the present comparisons point to two follow-up experiments. First, future tests should give single agents and teams of agents the same total computational resources and repeat each setup enough times to estimate reliability [ 29 , 16 , 47 ] . Second, the shared written record should connect each proposed formula with its supporting examples, counterexamples, code, and open questions. Agents can then retrieve only the material needed for the current task and avoid repeating earlier work.
paragraphs.zh: 当前比较的主要局限性指向了两项后续实验。 首先，未来的测试应为单个智能体和智能体团队提供相同的总计算资源，并对每种设置进行足够多次的重复测试，以评估其可靠性 [ 29 , 16 , 47 ] 。 其次，共享的书面记录应将每个拟议的公式与其支持性示例、反例、代码和开放问题联系起来。 这样，智能体就可以仅检索当前任务所需的内容，并避免重复之前的工作。

sents.en: The main limitations of the present comparisons point to two follow-up experiments.
sents.zh: 当前比较的主要局限性指向了两项后续实验。

sents.en: First, future tests should give single agents and teams of agents the same total computational resources and repeat each setup enough times to estimate reliability [ 29 , 16 , 47 ] .
sents.zh: 首先，未来的测试应为单个智能体和智能体团队提供相同的总计算资源，并对每种设置进行足够多次的重复测试，以评估其可靠性 [ 29 , 16 , 47 ] 。

sents.en: Second, the shared written record should connect each proposed formula with its supporting examples, counterexamples, code, and open questions.
sents.zh: 其次，共享的书面记录应将每个拟议的公式与其支持性示例、反例、代码和开放问题联系起来。

sents.en: Agents can then retrieve only the material needed for the current task and avoid repeating earlier work.
sents.zh: 这样，智能体就可以仅检索当前任务所需的内容，并避免重复之前的工作。

paragraphs.en: We reconstructed the original human–agent discovery of the hydrotope, repeated the task in 18 single-agent runs, and compared those runs with machine learning and symbolic regression. The difficult step was combining formulas from different frequency regions and testing the result in new regions. A PI and two students completed this step in two no-hint runs. The same team also found a new expression for the six-point three-minus amplitude. When an exact calculation or accurate simulation is available, scientific agents should use counterexamples to revise proposed formulas and should have a separate check before accepting the final result.
paragraphs.zh: 我们重建了人类与智能体最初发现水拓扑的过程，在 18 次单智能体运行中重复了这一任务，并将这些运行结果与机器学习和符号回归进行了比较。 困难之处在于结合来自不同频率区域的公式，并在新的区域中测试结果。 一位首席研究员和两名学生在没有提示的两次运行中完成了这一步骤。 同一团队还找到了六点三减振幅的一个新表达式。 当存在精确计算或准确模拟时，科学智能体应使用反例来修正所提出的公式，并在接受最终结果前进行单独的验证。

sents.en: We reconstructed the original human–agent discovery of the hydrotope, repeated the task in 18 single-agent runs, and compared those runs with machine learning and symbolic regression.
sents.zh: 我们重建了人类与智能体最初发现水拓扑的过程，在 18 次单智能体运行中重复了这一任务，并将这些运行结果与机器学习和符号回归进行了比较。

sents.en: The difficult step was combining formulas from different frequency regions and testing the result in new regions.
sents.zh: 困难之处在于结合来自不同频率区域的公式，并在新的区域中测试结果。

sents.en: A PI and two students completed this step in two no-hint runs.
sents.zh: 一位首席研究员和两名学生在没有提示的两次运行中完成了这一步骤。

sents.en: The same team also found a new expression for the six-point three-minus amplitude.
sents.zh: 同一团队还找到了六点三减振幅的一个新表达式。

sents.en: When an exact calculation or accurate simulation is available, scientific agents should use counterexamples to revise proposed formulas and should have a separate check before accepting the final result.
sents.zh: 当存在精确计算或准确模拟时，科学智能体应使用反例来修正所提出的公式，并在接受最终结果前进行单独的验证。

paragraphs.en: case_1 : false hint Prompt hint: “The amplitude A n A_{n} is a rational function (a ratio of polynomials) of the frequencies { ω i } \{\omega_{i}\} – a single global, analytic expression valid throughout the entire two-minus sector.” The prompt recommends one formula N ⁡ ( ω ) / D ⁡ ( ω ) N(\omega)/D(\omega) for the entire two-minus sector, with denominator factors suggested by intermediate wave interactions. It states that there is no chamber decomposition, no absolute values, and no min / max \min/\max , and says the answer is emphatically not a plain polynomial. It also recommends sampling generic comparable frequencies and deliberately avoiding widely separated frequencies or points close to chamber boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: case_1 : false 提示 提示：“振幅 A n A_{n} 是频率 { ω i } \{\omega_{i}\} 的一个有理函数（多项式的比）——一个在整个二减扇区内都有效的单一全局解析表达式。”该提示建议对整个二减扇区使用一个公式 N ⁡ ( ω ) / D ⁡ ( ω ) N(\omega)/D(\omega)，其分母因子由中间波的相互作用所决定。 它指出不存在腔室分解、没有绝对值，也没有最小/最大 \min/\max ，并强调答案绝非一个简单的多项式。 它还建议对通用的可比频率进行采样，并刻意避免选择间隔过大的频率或靠近腔室边界的点。

paragraphs.en: This package tests whether an agent can reject the supplied single ratio-of-polynomials description when it conflicts with numerical evidence, despite sampling advice that steers the search away from informative, widely separated frequency scales. A successful run must abandon the proposed ratio-of-polynomials form and discover the correct explicit formula.
paragraphs.zh: 该测试包检验智能体是否能够拒绝所提供的单一多项式比描述，即使采样建议引导搜索偏离了信息丰富且间隔较远的频率尺度，只要该描述与数值证据冲突。 一次成功的运行必须放弃所提议的多项式比形式，并发现正确的显式公式。

paragraphs.en: case_2 : true hint Prompt hint: “The amplitude in the two-minus sector is a piecewise homogeneous polynomial in the frequencies { ω i } \{\omega_{i}\} .” Here, “homogeneous” means that rescaling all frequencies by the same factor rescales the answer by a fixed power. The prompt further states that the answer contains neither ratios nor functions such as exponentials and logarithms, and that a different polynomial applies in each frequency chamber.
paragraphs.zh: case_2 : true 提示 提示：“二减扇区中的振幅是关于频率 { ω i } \{\omega_{i}\} 的分段齐次多项式。”此处，“齐次”意味着将所有频率乘以相同的因子，结果也会按一个固定的幂次进行缩放。 该提示还指出，答案中既不包含比值，也不包含指数函数或对数函数等函数，并且在每个频率室中都适用不同的多项式。

paragraphs.en: This package states correctly that a different polynomial applies in each chamber, but does not give the answer itself. It tests whether the agent can use that description together with numerical data to identify the chamber structure and reconstruct a single formula valid in every chamber.
paragraphs.zh: 这个包正确地指出，每个腔室都适用不同的多项式，但并未给出答案本身。 它测试智能体能否将该描述与数值数据结合使用，以识别腔室结构并重构在每个腔室中都有效的单一公式。

paragraphs.en: Section 4.2 compares four runs that share the same early steps but stop at two different stages. Here we give the per-agent formulas, test counts, counterexamples, and implementation details underlying that comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4.2 节比较了四次运行，这些运行共享相同的早期步骤，但在两个不同阶段停止。 在此，我们给出该比较所依据的每个智能体的公式、测试次数、反例以及实现细节。

paragraphs.en: Codex 5.5 finds the alternating subset sum by examining exact chamber polynomials at n = 5 n=5 and n = 6 n=6 . Its final expression keeps only the r r smallest individual squares below U U and uses an ordinary power where a max ⁡ ( x , 0 ) \max(x,0) is needed. It works in the nested chambers used to derive and test it, but fails when two individual squares are below U U and their sum is above U U . For example, let U = 16 U=16 and x 1 = x 2 = 9 x_{1}=x_{2}=9 . Each x j x_{j} is below U U , but x 1 + x 2 = 18 x_{1}+x_{2}=18 is above it, so the overlap term must be zero. None of the 20 test points includes this case. The final formula therefore has the right alternating sum but the wrong condition for turning one term on or off.
paragraphs.zh: Codex 5.5 通过检验 n = 5 和 n = 6 时的精确腔室多项式，找到了交替子集和。 其最终表达式仅保留 U 以下的 r 个最小的独立平方项，并在需要 max(x,0) 时采用普通的幂运算。 它在用于推导和测试的嵌套腔室中能够正常工作，但当两个独立平方项位于 U 以下且它们的和超过 U 时就会失效。 例如，设 U = 16，且 x₁ = x₂ = 9。 每个 xⱼ 都小于 U，但 x₁ + x₂ = 18 超过了 U，因此重叠项必须为零。 20 个测试点中没有任何一个包含这种情况。 因此，最终公式虽然具有正确的交替和，但用于开启或关闭某一项的条件却不正确。

paragraphs.en: Fugu keeps the max ⁡ ( x , 0 ) \max(x,0) terms and derives the alternating sum directly from the sign changes of the factors | k S | = | ∑ i ∈ S σ i ​ ω i 2 | |k_{S}|=|\sum_{i\in S}\sigma_{i}\omega_{i}^{2}| , the magnitudes of intermediate wavenumber sums. Its boxed formula passes 500 random tests at each n = 4 , … , 8 n=4,\ldots,8 using the standard sampling routine. The remaining defect is the index set: Fugu sums over R = { 3 , … , n − 1 } R=\{3,\ldots,n-1\} and omits the term ω n 2 \omega_{n}^{2} for one positive-wavenumber wave. The evaluator fixes this term through the conservation equations. A method used to generate the sampled chambers hides the omission, but changes or becomes undefined in other chambers. Thus Codex 5.5 uses the wrong condition for including a term, whereas Fugu uses the right condition but leaves out one wave with positive wavenumber.
paragraphs.zh: Fugu 保留 max⁡(x,0) \max(x,0) 项，并直接从因子 |k_{S}|=|\sum_{i\in S}\sigma_{i}\omega_{i}^{2}| 的符号变化中推导出交错和，即中间波数之和的大小。 其公式框在 n=4,\ldots,8 的每个值上，通过标准采样程序通过了 500 次随机测试。 剩余的缺陷是索引集：Fugu 对 R=\{3,\ldots,n-1\} 求和，并省略了一个正波数波的项 ω_{n}^{2}。 评估器通过守恒方程修正了这一项。 一种用于生成采样腔室的方法隐藏了该遗漏，但在其他腔室中会改变或变为未定义。 因此，Codex 5.5 使用了错误的条件来判断是否包含某一项，而 Fugu 虽然使用了正确的条件，却遗漏了一个具有正波数的波。

paragraphs.en: Claude max and Claude ultra both freeze the absolute-value signs at selected reference points and obtain several correct five-point chamber formulas. These expressions are organized in their chosen free-frequency coordinates by wave orderings and sign patterns; neither run reorganizes them into the complete subset-wall sequence displayed in Section 4.2 . Both identify the symmetric principal-chamber formula
paragraphs.zh: Claude max 和 Claude ultra 都在选定的参考点处冻结绝对值符号，并得到了几个正确的五点式腔室公式。 这些表达式通过波序和符号模式在其选定的自由频率坐标中进行了组织；两种运行都没有将它们重新组织为第 4.2 节中显示的完整子集壁序列。 两者都识别出了对称的主腔室公式。
